title: plasmashell crashes (SIGSEGV in Chromium extensions/PrefService) and leaks memory with 2+ Web Browser widgets active
line: Turning off private browsing in a Web Browser widget no longer crashes Plasma when another Web Browser widget is open.
explanation: Each widget created its own WebEngineProfile on the same storage name and switched it between private and persistent by flipping offTheRecord on the live profile. Qt WebEngine doesn't support changing a profile that pages use, nor two profiles sharing one storage, so with a second widget open the renderer startup hit freed preferences and plasmashell crashed. The change keeps one persistent profile in a QML singleton shared by all widgets and gives each widget its own off-the-record profile; the view switches between the two instead of changing a profile in place.

commits.message:
applets/webbrowser: Share one profile between all widgets

Turning off private browsing changed a profile that pages were using,
which crashed plasmashell when another widget was open. Use one on-disk
profile for all widgets, a private one per widget, and switch between.

BUG: 524649

patches.diff:
From 7e016708221ca0808453ed0f520b67f71f5b72dc Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 15:04:33 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/webbrowser: Share one profile between all widgets

Turning off private browsing changed a profile that pages were using,
which crashed plasmashell when another widget was open. Use one on-disk
profile for all widgets, a private one per widget, and switch between.

BUG: 524649
---
 applets/webbrowser/CMakeLists.txt        |  3 +++
 applets/webbrowser/qml/SharedProfile.qml | 23 +++++++++++++++++++++++
 applets/webbrowser/qml/main.qml          | 11 +++++++----
 3 files changed, 33 insertions(+), 4 deletions(-)
 create mode 100644 applets/webbrowser/qml/SharedProfile.qml

diff --git a/applets/webbrowser/CMakeLists.txt b/applets/webbrowser/CMakeLists.txt
index cfd0890ac..7c9d572ba 100644
--- a/applets/webbrowser/CMakeLists.txt
+++ b/applets/webbrowser/CMakeLists.txt
@@ -7,9 +7,12 @@ set_package_properties(Qt6WebEngineQuick PROPERTIES
 )
 
 if (Qt6WebEngineQuick_FOUND)
+    set_source_files_properties(qml/SharedProfile.qml PROPERTIES QT_QML_SINGLETON_TYPE TRUE)
+
     plasma_add_applet(org.kde.plasma.webbrowser GENERATE_APPLET_CLASS
         QML_SOURCES
             qml/main.qml
+            qml/SharedProfile.qml
             qml/ConfigAppearance.qml
             qml/ConfigGeneral.qml
             qml/config.qml
diff --git a/applets/webbrowser/qml/SharedProfile.qml b/applets/webbrowser/qml/SharedProfile.qml
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..87f664653
--- /dev/null
+++ b/applets/webbrowser/qml/SharedProfile.qml
@@ -0,0 +1,23 @@
+/*
+ *   SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Niccolò Venerandi <niccolo@venerandi.com>
+ *
+ *   SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
+ */
+
+pragma Singleton
+
+import QtQml
+import QtWebEngine
+
+// The profile that keeps cookies, logins and cache on disk. All Web Browser widgets share it, because Qt WebEngine
+// doesn't support two profiles on the same storage: they break each other's pages and logins.
+QtObject {
+    function instance(): WebEngineProfile {
+        return prototype.instance();
+    }
+
+    // Not the root object: the profile gets the prototype's parent, and without one it would be garbage collected
+    readonly property WebEngineProfilePrototype prototype: WebEngineProfilePrototype {
+        storageName: "org.kde.plasma.webbrowser"
+    }
+}
diff --git a/applets/webbrowser/qml/main.qml b/applets/webbrowser/qml/main.qml
index 38c005eb0..d8739638c 100644
--- a/applets/webbrowser/qml/main.qml
+++ b/applets/webbrowser/qml/main.qml
@@ -28,6 +28,11 @@ PlasmoidItem {
     Plasmoid.icon: "internet-web-browser-symbolic"
     hideOnWindowDeactivate: !Plasmoid.configuration.pin
 
+    // For private browsing: without a storage name, a profile is off the record
+    WebEngineProfilePrototype {
+        id: privateProfile
+    }
+
     // Only exists because the default CompactRepresentation doesn't expose
     // a way to display arbitrary images; it can only show icons.
     // TODO remove once it gains that feature.
@@ -289,10 +294,8 @@ PlasmoidItem {
                     parent = newParent;
                 }
 
-                profile: WebEngineProfile {
-                    storageName: Plasmoid.metaData.pluginId
-                    offTheRecord: Plasmoid.configuration.privateBrowsing
-                }
+                // Switching profiles reloads the page; changing a profile that is in use can crash
+                profile: Plasmoid.configuration.privateBrowsing ? privateProfile.instance() : SharedProfile.instance()
 
                 readonly property bool useMinViewWidth : Plasmoid.configuration.useMinViewWidth
 
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Two Web Browser widgets open; private browsing turned off in the first and Reload clicked: plasmashell crashes and restarts.
Same steps with the fix: the page switches profile and reloads, plasmashell keeps running.
Right after Reload: the popup is gone because plasmashell crashed (KCrash in the journal, new PID).
Right after Reload with the fix: the page is reloaded in the same plasmashell.
